answer: Register one vineyard terrace per applicant for 120 days, with a 150 token deposit and a 95 dollar license. A crystal spring feeds it through a metered pipe, and the keeper logs watering beside a photo of the vines. An opal marker at the terrace edge proves each photo was taken on site, and a neighbor signs the tally monthly. A forged log forfeits the deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 terraces freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars in licenses. Like a spring that runs only where rock is cracked, a fake terrace draws no water, so its dry vines give it away.
